name: swe-utility
description: Reusable utility skills for governed software engineering work.

interface.longDescription: Provides reusable discovery, review, orchestration, cross-repository delivery handoff, prototype-first delivery, style, domain-modeling, and versioning workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $grill to pressure-test a plan before implementation.
Use $orchestrate to coordinate a bounded multi-agent workflow.
Use $prototype -on or $prototype -off to control scoped prototype-first delivery.
Use $version to version, check in, synchronize, and tag approved work.
